description: The overview of a set of books in one read: the fiscal year to date (sales, expenses, net profit, money in and out) against the same days a year before, the last 12 months, today's cash, assets, liabilities and equity, every bank and cash account's balance, what customers owe and the business owes (with what is past due), the five largest expense categories, customers and vendors, sales tax charged and recoverable by filing period, and the major owners (shares, what each put in, lent and drew, and their share of this year's profit). Worked out from posted records: quote the reports for exact figures.
